personalInfo.heroDescription: As an engineer, I am deeply passionate about all aspects of low level programming and take great pleasure in integrating software with hardware components.
personalInfo.tagline: Building the bridge between software and hardware

about.shortBio: I'm a robotics and software engineer with extensive experience in hardware integration, embedded systems, computer vision, and mobile development across industries including autonomous vehicles, sports tech, entertainment, and healthcare.
description: My career spans over 10 years of building software that interacts with the physical world — from self-driving car systems and sports analytics platforms to theme park robots and IoT devices. I thrive at the intersection of low-level systems programming and high-level application development.

I've worked with technologies ranging from ROS/ROS2 and Jetson boards to Android and React, always focused on delivering robust, production-grade solutions. I'm also passionate about teaching and have served as an instructor for React and GraphQL.

When I'm not engineering, I enjoy working on personal robotics projects, contributing to open-source tools, and exploring new ways to push the boundaries of what's possible with hardware and software integration.
